snippet.title: Candy Land Adventure Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Candy Land Adventure Full Playthrough

Candy Land Adventure is a game created by Hasbro Interactive in 1996. In this game, you must help rescue King Kandy by outsmarting Lord Licorice, in which you will also save Candy Land.
